Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_disc_pct number(5,2);
 copy_sign number;
 current_sign number;
begin
/* if :order_charges.amount < 0.01
 then
 show_error_dist('7302');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;*/
 copy_sign := 0;
 current_sign := 0;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 if :cr_db_ind = 'PT'
 then
 begin
 select max(nvl(max_discount_pct,999))
 into temp_disc_pct
 from vserv_contracts
 where
 customer_id = (select max(customer_id) from
 orders where order_no = :ctrl_blk_1.s_order_no
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 if (:amount > temp_disc_pct)
 then
 show_error_dist('3707');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 if :cr_db_ind in ('DB','CR')
 then
 if :cr_db_ind = 'DB'
 then
 current_sign := 1;
 elsif
 :cr_db_ind = 'CR'
 then
 current_sign := -1;
 end if;
 if :s_cr_db_ind = 'DB'
 then
 copy_sign := -1;
 elsif
 :s_cr_db_ind = 'CR'
 then
 copy_sign := 1;
 end if;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_total := nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_total,0) +
 nvl(:s_amount,0) * copy_sign +
 nvl(:amount,0) * current_sign ;
 end if;
 if :cr_db_ind = 'PT'
 then
 if :s_cr_db_ind = 'CR'
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_total := nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_total,0) +
 nvl(:amount,0) ;
 elsif
 :s_cr_db_ind = 'DB'
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_total := nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_total,0) -
 nvl(:amount,0) ;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
 :s_amount := :amount;
 :s_cr_db_ind := :cr_db_ind;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FNC_INSERT_DATE(P_ORDER_DATE IN DATE) RETURN DATE IS
 v_local_time DATE;
BEGIN
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,p_order_date,v_local_time);
 else
 v_local_time := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 return v_local_time;
 
 exception
 when others then 
 return null;
 end; 
 -- 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: INITIALISE_WINDOWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE INITIALISE_WINDOWS IS
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 
 -- IM# 5084 (check to see time zone is enabled or not)
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 :global.time_zone_enabled := 'Y';
 else
 :global.time_zone_enabled := 'N';
 end if;
 
 -- IM# 5084 (Converts GMT date to local date)
 if :global.time_zone_enabled = 'Y' then
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_time);
 :local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 :local_date := sysdate; 
 end if;
 --
 
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_ORDER_NO_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT ord.order_no, ord.customer_id, SUBSTR(cu.name,1,30),
 TO_CHAR(lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, ord.insert_date), 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI')
 FROM orders ord, customers cu
 WHERE ord.order_status NOT IN ('CL','CA','SY','SH')
 AND cu.customer_id = ord.customer_id
 AND :local_date BETWEEN cu.eff_date AND NVL(cu.term_date, to_date(:local_date)+365)
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
 AND ord.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 AND cu.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id
 /*modified by hcl consulting*/
ORDER BY 1
